provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.en: I See, You Have No Shame

nameChecks.ja: その武器使えなくなるぞ？
覚悟はできてるだろうな？

gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Timekilling Time and Murder on the WARP Express records for the Normal story encounters. Guide variants 滅多切り and そんな･･･。 map to Mutilate and My...; middle-dot ellipses map to the original Cassetti skill names. Thirst for Blood and Tenacious follow mowe passive records, not similarly named statuses or other bosses. Normal, dungeon, and Hard values and target/deployment restrictions remain distinct. Hard-only names are referenced only to explain their exclusion.

lead.text: Start with Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion, each with 2 slots. Build SP and resources in Wave 1, then focus Pierce damage on the Captain in Wave 2. Once Staggered, concentrate damage and defeat him before the Unclashable “For the Greater Good”.

listLead.text: The 3 deployable Sinners are fixed, each starting with 2 slots. Prepare SP and resources in Wave 1, focus Pierce damage during Stagger, and shorten the period spent taking Unclashable attacks afterward.

statNote.text: The 2-wave focused encounter in 6.5-10. Boss Level 44, 582 HP, Defense Level 44. Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion can deploy; each starts with 2 slots and 1 T Corp. Special Investigator Badge. Stagger percentages and HP thresholds are unconfirmed. Lists all 7 boss skills; does not substitute the dungeon's Level 45, 633-HP version.

skillNote.text: Distinguishes on-use increases to the enemy's Tremor Count from on-hit effects on Sinners. “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable; Guard gains Shield at Combat Start. Check actual add types, numbers, and actions in combat.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 44 and Uptie III or higher on Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion. Do not build a plan requiring other Sinners to deploy.

priorities.1.text: Build SP and resources in Wave 1. The boss takes double Pierce and half Slash damage; prioritize leveled Pierce attackers.

priorities.2.text: Concentrate damage after Stagger and aim to kill before recovery. “For the Greater Good” cannot be stopped by clashing; prepare Evade or resistance if the fight lasts longer.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The usual main team cannot deploy

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion are available. Check their Identities and equipped E.G.O. Each starts with 2 slots, providing 6 actions despite the small team.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: The post-Stagger finisher cannot be stopped by a clash

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable. A powerful attack alone cannot stop it. Aim to kill during Stagger; otherwise, limit damage with Evade, resistance, and sufficient HP.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Suddenly easier to Stagger, with more additional damage

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Tremor - Decay lowers Defense Level, while entangled Reverb adds Sloth damage on Tremor Burst. Stop Tremor-inflicting attacks through clashes and check the target's Tremor and Stagger Threshold.

units.0.stagger.text: Unconfirmed (no percentage or HP value listed)

units.0.notes.0.text: The focused-encounter version appearing in Wave 2.

units.0.notes.1.text: Gains skill slots when adds die. No unconfirmed fixed slot cap is supplied.

units.0.notes.2.text: Prepare follow-up damage during Stagger for “For the Greater Good” after recovery.

phases.0.title.text: Build the 3 Sinners' SP and resources

phases.0.steps.0.text: Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion start with 2 slots each. Assign winning clashes and gather SP and resources for powerful E.G.O.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Prioritize Pierce and limit unnecessary hits and Tremor. Avoid entering Wave 2 with low SP or HP.

phases.0.steps.2.text: With only 3 Sinners, use defense and healing as well as attacks. Do not make an undeployed Sinner's skill part of the required sequence.

phases.1.title.text: Use Pierce to Stagger the boss

phases.1.steps.0.text: The boss takes double Pierce damage. Avoid concentrating damage into halved Slash; use available Pierce attacks to reach Stagger. Check the exact threshold in combat.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Enemy Tremor Count also increases on use; winning clashes does not stop all buildup. Check Sinners' Tremor and Tremor Burst conditions too.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Defeating adds increases boss slots. Handle necessary adds while retaining boss damage and answers to the additional attacks.

phases.2.title.text: Concentrate damage to kill before recovery

phases.2.steps.0.text: Once Staggered, focus strong attacks and defeat the boss before recovery. Avoid saving too much damage for the following turn.

phases.2.steps.1.text: “For the Greater Good” collects allies' Tremor Count at Combat Start to raise Offense Level, then adds 9 to own Count on use. It is Unclashable; ordinary clash-winning E.G.O cannot stop it.

phases.2.steps.2.text: If it is used, check Evade, resistance, and remaining HP. Repeated Bursts that Stagger a Sinner restore the enemy team's SP; avoid that chain of damage.

skills.0.response.text: Its own Tremor Count rises on use, even if you win the clash. Prevent the 2 Tremor inflicted on Sinners to limit later Burst conditions.

skills.1.name.text: I See, You Have No Shame

skills.1.response.text: Own Tremor Count rises on use; each hit inflicts 3 Tremor. Win clashes from the opening to limit buildup.

skills.2.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] At 10+ own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.2.effects.3.text: [On Hit] At 15+ Tremor Potency on the target, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce its Tremor Count by 1

skills.2.response.text: Coin 2 can trigger Tremor Burst at 10+ own Tremor Count or 15+ Tremor Potency on the target. Check Stagger Thresholds as well as Power when stopping it.

skills.3.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Decay

skills.3.response.text: Coin 3 converts the Sinner's Tremor into Decay, lowering Defense Level. Keep it off high-Tremor Sinners.

skills.4.effects.1.text: [On Use] Grant all other allies Tremor Count equal to own Tremor Count

skills.4.effects.2.text: [On Use] Convert all allies' Tremor, including self, into Tremor - Distribution

skills.4.effects.4.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Amplitude Entanglement with Tremor - Reverb

skills.4.response.text: Prioritizes Tremor - Decay targets. Distinguish on-use enemy-team distribution from on-hit Tremor and Reverb Entanglement. Stop the 4 hits to limit Burst damage.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to 3 times own Tremor Count (max 30)

skills.5.response.text: Gains Shield equal to own Tremor Count × 3 at Combat Start, capped at 30. Offset it or use enough damage to break through and reach Stagger.

skills.6.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Gain all other allies' Tremor Count, then remove Tremor from all allies

skills.6.effects.2.text: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Offense Level Up per 3 own Tremor Count

skills.6.effects.5.text: [On Hit] Deal additional Sloth damage of 10% per own Tremor Count

skills.6.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Deal additional Sloth damage of 10% per own Tremor Count

skills.6.effects.8.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Consume 3 own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst, and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.6.effects.9.text: [On Hit] Consume 3 own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst, and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.6.effects.10.text: [On Hit] Consume 3 own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst, and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.6.response.text: Unclashable, even against powerful E.G.O. Kill during Stagger or use Evade, resistance, and sufficient HP if it occurs. Repeated Bursts and additional Sloth damage are dangerous.

passives.0.response.text: Do not assume Panic alone will disable the enemy for long.

passives.1.condition.text: Staggering a target with own attacks or Tremor Burst

passives.1.response.text: Prevent a chain where your Sinners' Stagger lets the enemy team recover.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion may deploy. Each starts with 2 slots and 1 T Corp. Special Investigator Badge.

mechanics.0.response.text: Prepare all 3 Sinners and their E.G.O, dividing the total 6 actions between offense and defense.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Defense Level -1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Tremor Burst raises the Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency.

mechanics.1.response.text: Check Defense Level reduction and Stagger Thresholds; prevent Bursts on high-Tremor Sinners.

mechanics.2.effect.text: On Tremor Burst, take Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency, in addition to the Stagger Threshold increase.

mechanics.2.response.text: Limit how long the team must endure “For the Greater Good”'s repeated Bursts.

mechanics.3.effect.text: At Turn End, gain up to 5 Offense Level Up next turn based on total allied Tremor Count divided by living allies.

mechanics.3.response.text: The Captain converts the enemy team into this buff on use. In a long fight, check next-turn Offense Level too.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Conversion changes Tremor type; Entanglement combines effects as Tremor - Superposition. Potency and Count are retained. Superposition reverts to Tremor at Turn End.

mechanics.4.response.text: This combines Defense Level reduction with Burst damage; it is more than a name change.

warnings.0.text: Distinct from the Level 45, 633-HP Captain in the 6.5-15 dungeon.

warnings.1.text: Stagger thresholds, fixed add formations, and action cycles are unconfirmed. Do not lock a sequence to estimated values.

warnings.2.text: “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable. Evade success is not guaranteed either; check predictions and remaining HP.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 44 and Uptie III or higher on Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion. Prioritize leveled Identities with Pierce attacks.

preparation.1.text: Build SP and resources in Wave 1 and save high damage for Stagger.

preparation.2.text: Check defense and healing options for all 3 Sinners in case the fight lasts longer.

roles.0.reason.text: Exploit the boss's weakness and progress from Stagger to defeat.

roles.1.reason.text: Limit Tremor buildup and damage if the Unclashable attack occurs.

roles.2.reason.text: Avoid entering Wave 2 with any of the 3 Sinners unable to contribute.
